title: Team rooms, shared answers and update notices
items: 👥 Team is now one room for your team: Chat, Members and Shared answers. Messages arrive within seconds, and you see when a teammate is typing.
Trainer announcements are pinned at the top of your team room.
🤝 Share my answers (above an activity's worksheet) shares your answers with your team, on the days your trainer turns sharing on.

When a teammate shares the activity you are on, the lab offers to fill in your worksheet with their answers. Your trainer sees every copy. Steps are never copied: run the commands on your own terminal.
When every answer is filled in, the lab tells you the activity is ready to submit.
The lab now tells you when it has been updated. Your work is saved first, and you can finish what you are doing before updating.
trainer: Trainer board > 👥 Teams: drag trainees between teams, rename teams, or balance the class into mixed teams.
Settings > Answer Sharing turns sharing on per day. Copies show as ⧉ COPIED on the board and in the Copies tab.
Paste the new Code.gs, run setup and deploy a new version to switch this on.
